verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no assistant built into the product itself. The closest items are a pricing-page claim that you can 'spin up your store from a simple prompt', and Shopify's first-party AI Toolkit skill, which lets an external assistant such as Claude turn natural-language requests into UCP CLI commands. That is delegation through extra tools rather than an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: a documented built-in in-product AI assistant, evidence of which tasks it can take on and complete on its own, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
